description: U.S. Harmonized Tariff Schedule: current HTS revision (general, special-program and column 2 rates, chapter 99 additional duties) via the HTS REST export, plus manually imported USITC annual tariff databases (2024-2026)

source.license: US federal government work: public domain
source.attribution: U.S. International Trade Commission, Harmonized Tariff Schedule of the United States
source.access_notes: The annual tariff database ZIPs return 403 (bot protection) to scripted clients (verified 2026-09-15); download them in a browser and run `wm import usitc_hts_tariffs <file>`. The HTS REST export (hts.usitc.gov/reststop) answered scripted requests on 2026-09-15 and is acquired automatically.

acquisition.description: Current HTS revision as the full REST JSON export (headings 0100-9999 incl. chapter 99) plus the HTS release list (supplies the current revision name and start date). Annual tariff databases require manual import.

sampling.criteria: No bounded sample; use full acquisition or manual import
sampling.reason: Annual tariff database is bot-protected (manual download); HTS export is acquired in full
